plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Agent team & skill architect. A meta-skill (/harness:harness) that configures harnesses for your domain/project, defines specialist agents, and generates skills — plus ready-made packaged harnesses (e.g. /harness:meta-plugin (repo-org loop), /harness:rust-port (full-parity Rust port)) you can run in place or eject into a repo.
